throughline.zh: 10/18 至 10/21 已刊重點串連 AI 機房與伺服器、晶圓及先進封裝、PCB 設備人才、區域貿易與汽車設備交易，各自保留規劃及生效條件。
throughline.en: Published coverage for October 18–21 connects AI facilities and servers, wafers and advanced packaging, PCB equipment and talent, regional trade and an automotive-equipment transaction, retaining plan and effectiveness conditions.

title.zh: AI 機房與伺服器建置：營運、長約與投資分層披露
title.en: AI facilities and servers: separate operating, contract and investment disclosures

summary.zh: Bitdeer 10/19 新公布 9 月集團 GPU 利用率 95%，馬來西亞 A201 尚待 2027 年分階段交付；Aolani 同日公布最高 500 MW 非約束性意向書。台灣神雲約 126.2 億元新廠及擴線計畫於 10/19 公開，三案未披露彼此供應關係，規劃容量不能等同上線。
summary.en: Bitdeer’s October 19 update reports 95% September group GPU utilization, with Malaysia A201 awaiting staged delivery in 2027; Aolani separately announces non-binding LOIs for up to 500 MW. MiTAC discloses a roughly NT$12.62 billion Taiwan manufacturing plan; no supply relationship among the three is stated, and planned capacity is not live capacity.

title.zh: 晶圓、設備服務與先進封裝各有核准、投資及驗證節點
title.en: Wafers, equipment services and packaging have separate approval, investment and validation milestones

summary.zh: 據專業報導，JASM 10/16 獲准變更熊本二廠計畫，台灣光罩同日授權擬收購 TCK，原始文件取得仍有限。10/19 宸鴻提出兩年 60 億元 TGV 規劃，力成揭露區間合計約 7.39 億元封裝設備交易；規劃、授權及採購均未等同量產或交割完成。
summary.en: Professional reports describe JASM’s October 16 revised-plan approval and Taiwan Mask’s TCK acquisition authorization, with limited direct access to originals. On October 19, TPK outlines a two-year NT$6 billion TGV plan and PTI reports about NT$739 million in period equipment purchases; plans, authorization and purchases are distinct from production or closing.

title.zh: PCB 泰國設備交易與台灣產學合作分別公布
title.en: PCB equipment purchases in Thailand and academic cooperation in Taiwan

summary.zh: 臻鼎 10/19 揭露泰國子公司近一年設備交易約 10.86 億元，金額不是單日新增投資，原始公告依轉載核對。同日中央大學與臻鼎、台光、大量、尖點簽約，四家合計 6,000 萬元支持教學及研發，未公布新增產能或招生規模。
summary.en: Zhen Ding’s October 19 disclosure covers about NT$1.086 billion of Thai equipment transactions over nearly a year, not one day of investment, checked through a filing reproduction. NCU separately signs a combined NT$60 million teaching and research partnership with four PCB firms; new capacity and enrollment are unspecified.

title.zh: 越南協定簽署與新加坡出口統計分屬制度及需求資料
title.en: Vietnam’s trade signature and Singapore’s exports describe rules and demand separately

summary.zh: 越南與 EFTA 四國 10/18 簽署自由貿易協定，產品優惠與生效日仍待正式文本條件。新加坡 10/16 公布 9 月 NODX 年增 68.4%、對台年增 96.9%，總體增幅含船體不規則出貨與低基期，不能全歸因於 AI。
summary.en: Vietnam and four EFTA states signed an FTA on October 18, with product preferences and effective dates subject to definitive terms. Singapore’s October 16 release reports September NODX growth of 68.4% and Taiwan-bound growth of 96.9%; lumpy ship-structure exports and base effects prevent an AI-only explanation.

title.zh: 鴻海擬取得三菱電機移動半數股權，交割仍有條件
title.en: Foxconn proposes half of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, subject to closing conditions

summary.zh: 10/16 公布協議將 50% 股權對價定為 1,150 億日圓，合作涵蓋汽車設備業務。預定 2027/10/1 交割，須完成主管機關核准與契約條件，未披露新增訂單或工廠產量。
summary.en: The agreement announced October 16 values the proposed 50% stake at ¥115 billion and covers the automotive-equipment business. Closing is planned for October 1, 2027 subject to approvals and contractual conditions, without incremental orders or factory-output figures.
